version2-https://ing.dk/artikel/danish-c.summary: A recent report indicates that Danish businesses are increasingly integrating artificial intelligence into their operations, yet employment statistics show no significant job reductions. The central bank attributes this to the complementary nature of AI, which is enhancing productivity rather than displacing workers.
